metadata.Long Title: An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers and for the said purpose, to establish authorities for timely and effective administration and settlement of consumers' disputes and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
metadata.Department: Department of Consumer Affairs Ministry Of Consumer Affairs  Food And Public Distribution
metadata.Notification: 20th July, 2020,  Notification No. SO 2351(E) dated 15th July 2020, SO 2351(E) dated 15-07-2020.
